title: Wrecked (TV series)
premise_summary: Wrecked is an American sitcom that was created by Jordan Shipley and Justin Shipley for TBS. The series is about a group of people stranded on an island, after their airplane crashed in the ocean and is a parody of Lost. The 10-episode first season premiered on June 14, 2016.
